hook: Lean found unreported bugs in Clojure's core.
hookText: Lean found unreported bugs in Clojure's core

beats.say: The author checked Clojure version 1.12.7, released on November 18, 2026, using JDK 21 and the Lean theorem prover.
One bug hid in a bit mask meant to clear the low five bits and round down to a multiple of thirty-two: it also cleared bit sixteen and everything above it.
With the fix in place, Lean proved the check matches the naive specification for every thirty-two-bit input.
